Frequently asked questions

Common questions about request an ssi administrative law judge hearing

How do I request an SSI hearing?

File a Request for Hearing by Administrative Law Judge within 60 days of the reconsideration denial. The process is the same as SSDI hearings.

What should I bring to an SSI hearing?

Bring updated medical records, financial documentation, a list of medications, and any witnesses who can testify about your condition. Your representative will prepare the evidence submission.
